label: first copy step after <DEL> in long (L=9) sequences starting with j or p
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, at the single step right after <DEL> (recall_idx 1, prev_tok <DEL>), where the input is the fed-back first original token. Almost all of it is in L=9 sequences (93% of mass at t=10), with a little at L=8 (t=9). It is strongly selective for the first token: j (59% of mass) and p (29%), then a small tail of 3, 1 and q. The largest activations are all j or p at L=9. Never fires in the original or delimiter phases, at other copy positions, or for most other first tokens. Precision is low (about 26% on dev): most L=9 j/p sequences stay below threshold, and I found no secondary variable that cleanly separates them (n_digits and next_out each give only small gains). It looks like the thresholded tail of a continuous response to the combination of first token, length and position.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: recall_idx=1 & in_tok=j (+6.14), recall_idx=1 & in_tok=p (+4.96), recall_idx=1 & in_tok=3 (+2.81), t=10 & in_tok=q (+2.29), t=10 & in_tok=1 (+2.20), phase=2 & out_tok=1 (+1.71). Lower it: orig7=- (-3.24), orig1=j (-1.47), orig5=x (-1.23), orig2=r (-1.23).
